seoTitle: Akron Public Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Akron Public Schools grades 1–12 start Aug. 27, 2026. Kindergarten phases in Aug. 27–28; Pre-K and kindergarten begin Aug. 31. See breaks, no-school days, PDF and ICS.
heroSummary: Akron Public Schools grades 1–12 start Thursday, August 27, 2026. Kindergarten phase-in is August 27–28, and Pre-K and kindergarten begin Monday, August 31. The last day for students is Thursday, June 3, 2027. The Thanksgiving holiday is November 26–27; students are also off November 25 for conferences. Winter break runs December 21–January 1, and spring break is March 29–April 2.
heroSourceLine: 2026–27 dates · Reviewed against the official APS PDF and live district calendar
calendarNotes: The one-page APS PDF lists August 27 as the first day for students. The live district calendar adds that grades 1–12 start August 27, kindergarten phases in August 27–28, and Pre-K and kindergarten begin August 31. September 25, November 3, January 29 and May 4 are professional-development days with no students. Parent-teacher conferences close school to students November 25 and February 12, while January 15 is a records day with no students. Thanksgiving closes schools and offices November 26–27. Students are off for winter break December 21–January 1, while district offices close only December 24–25, December 31 and January 1. Good Friday closes schools and offices March 26, immediately before spring break March 29–April 2. Marking periods end October 30, January 14, March 25 and June 3; those dates are not closures unless the calendar says otherwise. June 3 is the last day for students, followed by the last teacher and staff day June 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Akron Public Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 start Thursday, August 27, 2026. Kindergarten phase-in is August 27–28, and Pre-K and kindergarten begin Monday, August 31.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Akron APS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. APS offices close December 24–25, December 31 and January 1.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Akron APS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 29 through Friday, April 2, 2027. Good Friday on March 26 closes schools and offices immediately before the break.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day for Akron APS students in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, June 3, 2027, which is also the end of the fourth marking period. June 4 is the last day for teachers and staff.

calendarFaqs.q: Are APS offices closed whenever students are off?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Staff development, records and conference dates are student no-school days, but the calendar does not identify district offices as closed. During Winter Break, offices close only December 24–25, December 31 and January 1.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the district calendar apply to Early College, STEM and other specialty programs?
calendarFaqs.a: It covers districtwide dates, but specialty programs may publish additional orientation, testing and event dates. Check the assigned school or program calendar as well.
